flows.title: Create a presentation
steps: Open the Google Slides home screen.

flows.title: Present a slideshow full screen
steps: Open a presentation in Google Slides.
In the top right, click Slideshow. For best results, present with Google Chrome.
The presentation becomes full screen from the current slide. To change slides, use the arrow keys or click the arrows at the bottom of the presentation.
To leave full screen, press the Esc key.

flows.title: Present with speaker notes
steps: Open a presentation in Google Slides.
In the top right corner, next to Slideshow, click the Down arrow.
